page.overview:
Who is Barn kittens?

The barn kittens are a group of cats that appear in .

These were a group of kittens that lived together in a barn. Michael Myers entered the building to search for Samantha Thomas and Spitz so that he could murder them. While the teenagers were both killed, the kittens all went unharmed.
